name: dsh-web-search-yandex
description: Native Yandex-backed WebSearchProvider plugin for DeepSeek Harness: registers into the ctx.web seam so the model-facing web_search tool queries the Yandex Cloud Search API directly, with no local HTTP proxy hop. The repo root IS the plugin package (dsh.bundle), so it installs with a single `dsh plugin add github:owner/repo`.
